newsitem.title: GERMANY: German prosecutors charge Schneider with fraud.
newsitem.headline: German prosecutors charge Schneider with fraud.

text.p: The Frankfurt prosecutor's office said on Monday it had filed fraud charges against former property tycoon Juergen Schneider in connection with the collapse of his real estate empire in 1994.
The office said it had charged Schneider on December 17 with credit fraud in two cases, particularly serious fraud in three cases and with one case of bankruptcy.
Schneider has been held in a Frankfurt prison since he was extradited from Miami last February.
The office said that Schneider's wife Claudia had been charged with bankruptcy and that a Schneider associate, Karl-Heinrich Kuepferle, had been charged with abetting fraud.

Schneider, once one of Germany's most celebrated entrepreneurs, fell from grace when he and his wife vanished in April 1994, leaving their company to crumble under more than five billion marks of debt.
The Schneiders were detained in Miami in 1995 after a year-long international manhunt. They returned voluntarily to Germany last February to face questioning.
Claudia Schneider has been conditionally freed from detention because of concern for her health.
